title: Log as Planks
description: Craft all items that require only Planks, using Log
body:
#

Log as Planks

## A Minecraft datapack that adds alternative vanilla-friendly crafting recipes, allowing players to use logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo directly in any recipe that normally requires only wooden planks — **save time**!
📖 Recipes - Sticks from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Chests from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Wooden stairs from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Wooden slabs from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Wooden pressure plates from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Wooden doors from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Wooden trapdoors from logs/stems/blocks-of-bamboo - Wooden boats from logs - Bamboo rafts from blocks of bamboo
## 📄 Installation 1. Download the datapack `.zip` file 2. Place it in your world's `datapacks/` folder 3. Run `/reload` in-game or load a new world
